---
title: "M3 - Standalone Module"
---

## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M3 - Speech Synthesis.

## Technical Scope

- Python 3.11 or 3.12 runtime
- Streamlit frontend plus standalone CLI scripts
- Argos Translate integration for multilingual text transformation
- Configurable OpenAI-compatible or local backend integration depending on model setup
- Intended for prototyping and integration workflows

## Run Guidance

streamlit run app.py

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
